what_happened: Dispatch's measured insertion point (~1048-1125) for orchestrate-cycle-postflight.sh's completion arm was stale by the time research ran: task 330 landed in between and shifted the file to 1762 lines. Re-measured: dispatch_status case spans 950-1256, WORK (m) metrics write spans ~1486-1544, WORK (i) commit begins 1545. Recorded the re-measurement in the research report so the plan phase does not inherit the stale numbers.

Research report's re-measurement of orchestrate-cycle-postflight.sh (1762 lines; WORK (m) metrics at 1491-1543; persisted_status at ~1697-1711) confirmed unchanged at plan time, so the dispatch's stale ~1048-1125 estimate was superseded without a second measurement pass. The report's option-(b) insertion-point recommendation was adopted directly as plan Decision D4.

Plan-time discovery not in the research report: an existing fixture suite (scripts/tests/test-orchestrate-cycle-postflight.sh, 2452 lines) enumerates every collaborator script it copies into its sandbox, so the new run-task-observers.sh must be added to both its require_file list and its setup_sandbox copy loop or the suite silently exercises the non-fatal missing-script branch instead of the real call. Added as explicit tasks in plan Phase 4.

Phase 1 (routing_resolve_observers resolve-all ladder) implemented and verified in one pass: bash -n on all 10 dependents, shellcheck clean, test-routing-resolution.sh unchanged/passing, and ad-hoc fixture smoke test confirmed prefix-aware topic/task_type match-if-either and non-match cases.

Phase 3's initial test fixture for case (l) (failing-observer-does-not-change-status) assumed run-task-observers.sh sandboxes an observer's own filesystem writes, which it does not (out of scope for an advisory invoker). Redesigned the fixture to assert the SUT's own exit code and non-mutation of state.json, with the observer only emitting garbage stdout/stderr rather than writing to state.json.

Phase 4 (WORK (n) postflight invocation site, re-measured by comment marker per the plan's own warning) landed clean on the first mechanical pass: all 171 cases in test-orchestrate-cycle-postflight.sh pass with zero regressions including 4 new end-to-end observer acceptance cases, and the ordering assertion case in test-run-task-observers.sh confirms WORK (n) at line 1744 runs after dispatch-metrics.sh (1550), issue-record.sh (1258), and persisted_status= (1715).

Phase 7 full-battery run (run-all.sh, 111 suites) confirms zero regressions from this task: test-run-task-observers.sh (15/15), test-orchestrate-cycle-postflight.sh (171/171 incl. 4 new end-to-end observer cases), and test-routing-resolution.sh (13/13 unchanged) are all green. The 5 NEW and 3 expected failures elsewhere in the sweep are pre-existing, confirmed via git log to trace to other tasks (326, 329, 327, 148, 1012, 240, 995), not this one. verify-deploy.sh --skip-slow and check-extension-docs.sh (plain and STRICT_CORE_DEPLOY=1) both PASS clean, and the deployed run-task-observers.sh confirmed inert (exit 0 silent, events.jsonl unchanged) against a real task identity.
